description: Build diagnose_mcp_scanner_stale.py to diagnose the mcp_scanner daemon which is currently 5h3m stale (heartbeat threshold 4h). This is a diagnostic-only file per Appendix A (KNOWN_BROKEN section — prefer diagnosis over rebuild; file is protected). The module must: (1) Query service_health for mcp_scanner last_heartbeat via write_service. (2) Tail the mcp_scanner log to find the last successful activity line. (3) Run get_pending_scans_count to check if work queue is accumulating. (4) Parse log for ERROR/WARNING patterns indicating failure mode. (5) Write a diagnostic blob to a dedicated diagnostics table via write_service. (6) Include a run() entrypoint with if __name__ == '__main__'. Uses: write_service on :8772 (Section 5 inter-daemon rule — no direct DB access). Do NOT propose service restart; diagnostics only.
